summary: The amendment resolves the original findings but introduces two requirement conflicts.
blocking_findings: F3 [Blocker] spec.md FR-3 and acceptance criteria: The new chained-command claim requires allow even when the command also has a denied redirect. Rationale: The same requirements require the redirected shape to be denied, so the outcomes conflict.

F4 [Blocker] spec.md FR-2 and Tech-debt note for closeout: FR-2 prohibits changes outside its exact file list, but closeout must add a row to measure/tech-debt.md. Rationale: The required debt file is not in the permitted change set.
evidence: HEAD equals the supplied baseline, and the initial branch and worktree match the brief.
F1 resolved: FR-1 and FR-3 name the accepted chained-command gap and test its expected effect.
F2 resolved: FR-2 now explicitly includes the new contract test.
FR-3 requires deny for the redirected shape and allow for a role-gate command containing ; rm x without excluding redirects.
The new tech-debt note requires a row at closeout, while FR-2 excludes measure/tech-debt.md from its exact change set.
The repository index identifies measure/tech-debt.md as the tech-debt registry.

paraphrase.proposes: Add a role-gate allow rule to eight audit roles and add a contract test. Record the chained-command gap and add a tech-debt row at closeout.
paraphrase.current_system: Audit roles allow shell commands and then deny unanchored word patterns. A phase heading matches one deny pattern, which blocks the role-gate command.
